content.value: A prism was coated with a thin layer of silver $( \mathfrak { E } _ { \mathfrak { m } } = - 2 7 . 6$ at λ = 800 nm), and placed in an (09) aqueous environment $( n _ { d } { = } 1 . 3 3 )$ . Light from a focused LED was incident on the rear surface of the silver through the prism $( n _ { p } { = } 1 . 5 0 )$ , and scanned through a range of incident angles. Using the equations provided, calculate the Plasmon resonance angle of the system.
